messages:
Maria (partnerships): hey team, looping everyone in — Quantus just sent draft distro terms for their new open weights. can we do a quick sync on what we can accept for marketplace + HW bundles?
Eli (legal): quick read — looks close to BSD but with a clause: 'no resale of weights outside approved marketplace channels' — we need clarity on 'resale'.
Tess (product): by resale do they mean rehosting as a service, or bundling into paid HW devices? that distinction matters for our dedicated offering.
Lee (Quantus): thanks for the ping. intent is to allow commercial use & redistribution via certified partners (marketplace / approved HW partners). not okay: unlicensed third-party rehosts that republish model as an API.
Devin (engineering): from infra POV, we can add gating to our marketplace artifacts so only signed bundles are available. devops needs a manifest + checksum.
Eli (legal): two asks: 1) tighten 'approved partners' definition and approval process, 2) export control carveouts (we should require compliance w/ our export list). also: attribution text required in product docs.
Maria (partnerships): Lee — can Quantus accept a clause that we will be the only authorized distributor for cloud marketplace listings and that HW partners must sign a redistribution addendum?
Lee (Quantus): yes, willing to accept a distributor model. addendum okay. we'll also provide a provenance manifest and model card.
Tess (product): operational checklist request: 1) model card, 2) quantized artifacts (4/8 bit) + conversion notes, 3) checksums, 4) license file, 5) attribution blurb, 6) export control classification (ECCN).
Devin (engineering): note on packaging: prefer OCI image per our marketplace rules. if partner wants raw weights for on-prem, require signed tarball and signed manifest. ops-bot: creating task in intake queue: #A-3421.
Eli (legal): also confirm whether training data attribution or derivative restrictions exist. if Quantus has any third-party-data constraints we can't redistribute.
Lee (Quantus): provenance includes dataset provenance statement. no third-party embargoes, but a couple of upstream license obligations for attribution — we'll detail them in the manifest.
Tess (product): timeline? we need legal signoff + engineering packaging in 2 weeks to hit our next marketplace refresh.
Maria (partnerships): action items: Eli to draft distributor addendum and export clause by Wed (1723530000), Lee to share manifest + model card by Fri, Devin to mock OCI package spec. I will coordinate partner comms.
Eli (legal): ack, will draft. one more: we should require a revocation procedure if Quantus pulls distribution rights — how will we delist and notify downstream HW partners?
Lee (Quantus): we can provide a 30-day notice window and a signed revocation endpoint. we'll put that in the addendum.
Devin (engineering): technically we can add TTL on marketplace artifacts and push a deprecation flag; for HW partners we can revoke signing keys which blocks new installs (but not existing firmware). will document risks.
Maria (partnerships): good call — we'll include a deprecation playbook for partners and a recommended firmware migration note.
Tess (product): I'll draft the partner-facing playbook with steps for delist, migration, and attribution updates.
ops-bot: task #A-3421 created and assigned to Devin, status: open
Maria (partnerships): thanks everyone. i'll consolidate and send a summary to Quantus. :thumbsup:
Lee (Quantus): appreciate it — will follow up with manifest + ECCN later today.
Eli (legal): will post draft addendum into the thread when ready.
Devin (engineering): starting OCI spec draft now.
Maria (partnerships): closing loop — will post summary + next meeting invite once Eli's draft is in.
